title: Desktop Intent Result v1
description: Content-light result from executing a desktop intent. Never includes raw prompts, model outputs, source code, stdout/stderr bodies, diffs, secrets, or raw private paths.

intent_id.description: Matches the intent_id from the request.

result_kind.description: Kind of result data: summary, projection, error, etc.

output_refs.description: References to generated output files (paths relative to repo root).

projection_refresh_recommended.description: True if the projection should be refreshed after this intent.

authorization_required.description: True if this intent requires a receipt-gated future authorization step.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code when status is refused or failed.
